column4: cleat#2972: the emit mode is requested by TWO env vars (CLEAT_OPENAPI_SCHEMA_SIDECAR, CLEAT_OPENAPI_DOC_OUT), and the only caller that sets them is .github/workflows/openapi-client.yml own step. Nothing in an ordinary run asks for a document, so there is nothing for this test to measure: check-skips.sh case (a), a genuinely optional resource, which is why the skip is correct rather than a hole being papered over. It is deliberately NOT the fatal-when-CI shape used for a missing toolchain -- this package runs in CI WITHOUT those vars under several jobs, including the two lines here, so CI-fatal would fail them for doing the right thing. Measured by name: go test ./cmd/cleat-worker/ -run ^TestEmitOpenAPIDocumentForTheGeneratedClientCheck$ -count=1 -json | grep -c Action:skip reports exactly 1.

cleat#2972: the same test and the same two env vars. This entry runs ./cmd/..., so it reaches cmd/cleat-worker and the skip lands here too; the ledger wants one line per (job key, reason) and a job budget is the SUM of its lines. Same reasoning as the test-go/core line beside it.
